verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server that any MCP-capable external agent can connect to so it can query live telemetry and investigate latency or error spikes. It also offers a documented REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec for programmatic management of queries and datasets. Traces, logs, and metrics all land in Honeycomb via OTLP, so they are queryable through these interfaces, and a community report describes agents using Honeycomb traces during incidents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server debugging production; detailed docs on running queries over logs and metrics through the API (the probe also found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths).
